name: toast-notify
description: Windows toast notifications when a long turn or command finishes, when Claude waits for permission, when a turn stalls, and when a turn fails.

minTurnSeconds.title: Minimum turn seconds
minTurnSeconds.description: A finished turn shorter than this raises no toast. Failed turns always do.

minCommandSeconds.title: Minimum command seconds
minCommandSeconds.description: A Bash or PowerShell command that ran at least this long raises a toast when it finishes.

stallSeconds.title: Stall seconds
stallSeconds.description: A turn with no model output or tool call for this long raises a toast. 0 disables it.
